about: Deliberate behaviour changes made after the Python 0.2.2 record in python-cases.json was frozen. tests/parity.rs replaces the listed answers by corpus index before comparing, so python-cases.json stays exactly as Python left it. Each change gives its reason and every case it alters. The optional evidence fields receipt_evidence, mvr_status and fund_error_ref joined the canonical mapping on 8 November 2026. They annotate a line and change no verdict, so they are not a change of their own here: every amended answer that prints the default mapping or a list of the valid fields carries them.

changes.change: Employment Hero Beam 'Reconciled' is not sent to the fund (26 October 2026). Beam reports Reconciled once it has cleared the employer's money, before 'Sent to fund' (yourpayroll Super Contributions Report; Reckon's Beam status guide), so a Reconciled row gets no remitted date. The profile then gained every other status the vendor lists (30 October 2026): 'Sent to fund with response' and manual 'Paid' are transmission evidence or the employer's assertion, so sent; 'Sent to fund with refund', 'Cancelled', 'Failed', 'Refunded', 'Not actioned' and 'Payment failed' do not establish remittance, so they get no date.

super_profile.name: Employment Hero / KeyPay - Super Contributions (payments)
super_profile.notes: The payments CSV carries a Status column at the far right. Beam statuses run Created, Submission accepted, Awaiting payment, Awaiting clearance, Reconciled, Sent to fund, with Sent to fund with response, Sent to fund with refund, Cancelled, Failed and Refunded as the other automated outcomes. A contribution outside any batch is Not actioned, and a manual batch runs Created, then Paid or Payment failed. None of them is a fund receipt date. Sent to fund and Sent to fund with response (a fund replied with warnings or notes) are transmission evidence only, and Paid is the employer's own assertion, so those dates are remittance dates and nothing more. Every other status does not establish remittance, so its row gets no remitted date; that is not proof that no money moved. Awaiting clearance and Reconciled (Beam has cleared the employer's money but not sent it on) remain pending even if an employer payment date is present. Sent to fund with refund says a fund rejected and refunded some contributions without saying which, so its row is written returned_by_fund=yes and stays UNKNOWN until each contribution is reconciled against the batch history. A status outside this list is refused rather than guessed.
